feature: retain sent Health Watch across local response-read interruptions
regression_before: the new real h2c read-interruption test failed against base behavior: Canceled from response-read admission reset the gRPC stream and ReconnectingWatch cleared its active Watch

behavior.transport_read: gRPC duplex transport-read Timeout remains resumable unless its RPC deadline controls the read; Canceled and ConcurrencyUnavailable preserve stream and decoder when HTTP/2 remains usable
behavior.health: ReconnectingWatch propagates the original local read error while retaining the active sent Watch, partial input, last observed status, attempt count and retry state
behavior.ordinary_gate: local resource backoff on a retained active Watch preserves its last health observation, allowing a known SERVING backend to keep receiving calls while its Watch remains quiet; setup failures without retained observation still reject admission
behavior.terminal_boundaries: explicit stream/Watch cancellation, unusable transport, RPC deadline expiry, decode failures and consumer callback failures retain their existing terminal behavior

regressions: real h2c peer splits its response at no input, four bytes of the HTTP/2 frame header, the last HPACK byte and the DATA/gRPC length prefix; both cancellation and executor admission faults preserve stream ID, one active stream, next stream ID 3, no retry timer and exact status/terminal delivery

real background Gate receives SERVING, then its response-read executor admission fails and local backoff is paused; original Watch stream and SERVING state remain stable while a default-mode business unary call completes

the existing bounded-message consumer failure test now returns RejectSecond, Canceled and ConcurrencyUnavailable from callbacks; each still sends INTERNAL_ERROR reset, releases unread DATA and permits later connection reuse

independent Node HTTP/2 peer sends literal Health protobuf SERVING, withholds the next update until native confirmation of both injected read errors, then sends NOT_SERVING and UNIMPLEMENTED; it requires one Watch and no aborted/reset stream
verification.independent_peer: Node HTTP/2 framing and literal protobuf Health payloads; the existing response-policy matrix still compares against pinned grpc-js 1.14.0

remaining_scope: Broader gRPC composite/xDS integration and multi-hour/high-concurrency evidence remain open for the complete HTTP/WebSocket/WebTransport/MQTT/gRPC goal.
